newsitem.title: USA: SOS Staffing cuts offering to 2.2 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: SOS Staffing cuts offering to 2.2 mln shrs.

text.p: SOS Staffing Services Inc said Thursday it plans to cut the size of its planned secondary offering to 2.2 million shares from the original 3.7 million shares.

The company said it intends to amend its pending registration statement to reflect a decline in the market price of its common stock to 10-1/8, as of December 11, from 12-1/8, as indicated in the initial filing of the registration statement.

SOS Staffing said it now plans to sell two million shares. Selling shareholders, consisting of a charitable foundation originally established by the company's chairman and a church, plan to sell 200,000 shares.
The selling shareholders will not include any SOS principals, the company said.
